group.label: Hypernode
group.comment: Lets the assistant report server load, PHP-FPM workers, HTTP traffic and Hypernode Insights annotations through the hypernode_status skill. On a Hypernode the app name and token are detected automatically; fill them in only to override or when Magento runs elsewhere.

field.label: App name
field.comment: The Hypernode app name, e.g. "yourshop" for yourshop.hypernode.io. Leave empty to detect it from the hostname.

field.label: API token
field.comment: Found in /etc/hypernode/hypernode_api_token on the node. Leave empty to read that file directly. The token is never sent to the AI provider.

field.label: Nginx access log
field.comment: Path of the JSON access log the http_traffic action reads (default /var/log/nginx/access.log).
